subject: Adverse event report from our French clinic (form in French, attached)
bodyText:
Dear Safety Team,

I'm writing on behalf of our clinic in Lyon, France, to report an adverse reaction in one
of our patients. Our internal reporting form is completed in French, as that is our
standard documentation language - I've attached it as a PDF.

In brief: a 59-year-old female patient developed a generalized rash with intense itching
and mild eyelid swelling approximately six days after starting Nortavex 40 mg daily. The
medication was stopped and an oral antihistamine was prescribed; symptoms resolved over
about five days. She was not hospitalized.

Please let me know if you need this translated further or if the attached form is
sufficient for your review process.

Best regards,
Dr. Camille Rousseau
Clinique Saint-Aubin, Lyon
